Session date: 5:44 pm on 3 June, 2022
[D14:14] Nate: I talked to some of the guys at the tournament afterwards, and they said they wanted to hang out later!
[D14:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a purple and blue controller with a star field design
[D14:15] Joanna: Sounds like fun! It's good to have friends that share your interests!
[D14:16] Nate: For sure! They asked for some tips in how to improve their game, so I said I could help.
[D14:17] Joanna: Good on you for helping strangers out! Stepping outside your comfort zone is always great.
[D14:18] Nate: Thanks, I just like helping people. Do you have any plans for the weekend?
[D14:19] Joanna: Yep, I'm hiking with some buddies this weekend. We're checking out a new trail with a rad waterfall. Can't wait! Do you have any fun plans?
[D14:20] Nate: Sounds great! Have fun with that. I'm organizing a gaming party two weekends later - it'll be hectic but fun!
[D14:21] Joanna: Oh? Are you going to invite your tournament friends?
[D14:22] Nate: Definitely! And some old friends and teamates from other tournaments.
[D14:23] Joanna: Sounds like fun, Nate! I wish you the best on your party. Have a blast!
[D14:24] Nate: Thanks Joanna! I'm sure it'll be a blast. I'm even getting everyone custom controller decorations just for coming!
[D14:25] Joanna: Wow, I bet they'll love that! What a sweet idea.
[D14:26] Nate: I know right? Have a great hike. Take lots of pics! See ya later!
[D14:27] Joanna: Thanks Nate! See you later!
Session date: 2:12 pm on 5 June, 2022
[D15:1] Joanna: Hey Nate! Yesterday was crazy cool - I wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen yesterday! It was nerve-wracking but so inspiring to see my words come alive!
[D15:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a spider - man poster hanging on a wall
[D15:2] Nate: Congrats, Joanna! Seeing your hard work pay off like that must've felt amazing. I bet it was scary too, but awesome! You're so inspiring. By the way, last time we saw eachother, I noticed a spiderman pin on your purse. Is Spider-Man your favorite superhero, or do you have another fave?
[D15:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It was a real roller coaster, but seeing the hard work pay off was amazing. Spider-Man has always been a favorite of mine - I mean, who doesn't love Peter Parker's struggles between being a hero and being a person? But I'm kind of a sucker for any superhero - everyone has their own rad story and powers. Do you have a favorite superhero?
[D15:4] Nate: That's great, Joanna! Iron Man is my top pick. I love his tech and that sarcastic humor. Seeing these figures just makes me feel invincible!
[D15:4] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a toy iron man standing on a white surface
[D15:5] Joanna: Wow, Nate! That's awesome. I love the tech and funny jokes of Iron Man too. What made you get that figure?
[D15:6] Nate: Thanks Joanna! I got it because it reminded me of something I love. Its presence in my room is a good reminder to keep working on my goals. Any inspiring things in your room?
[D15:7] Joanna: My cork board is full of inspiring quotes and pictures for motivation and creativity. It's my little corner of inspiration.
[D15:8] Nate: Wow Joanna, that sounds great! Could you show me a picture of it?
[D15:9] Joanna: Here ya go, a pic of my cork board. It's got quotes, photos, and little keepsakes.
[D15:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a picture frame with a picture of a family
[D15:10] Nate: That's a great pic of your family! What made you hang it on your cork board?
[D15:11] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Having that picture on my cork board reminds me of the love and encouragement from them every day.
[D15:12] Nate: That's great, Joanna. Family support is invaluable. It's so good to have those reminders.
[D15:13] Joanna: Absolutely, it means a lot and keeps me going.
[D15:14] Nate: I really should start a cork board of my own shouldn't I. That seems like a really valuable thing!
[D15:15] Joanna: I would definitely recommend it! As long as your willing to explain what it is to your friends.
[D15:16] Nate: Of course! Well see you later Joanna!
[D15:17] Joanna: Bye Nate!
Session date: 10:55 am on 24 June, 2022
[D16:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no see! How have you been? I just got done submitting my recent screenplay to a film contest just to see how others might like it!
[D16:2] Nate: That's really cool Joanna! I hope it does well, and I've been doing great! The gaming party was a great success! We even played some Chess afterward just for fun.
[D16:3] Joanna: Nice! Did your friends like the controller accessories?
[D16:4] Nate: Most of them did! I can't say if all of them will continue to use them or not, but that's beside the point.
[D16:5] Joanna: Yeah Nate, you're right. It doesn't matter if they use it, its the thought that matters right?
[D16:6] Nate: Absolutely! There were 7 people that attended, and 6 of them said they'd want to do it again next month!
[D16:7] Joanna: That sounds like a huge success then! Congrats!
[D16:8] Nate: Thanks! On another note, I made vegan ice cream last Friday and shared it with some people in my vegan diet group. It was awesome!
[D16:8] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a group of people sitting on a bench
[D16:9] Joanna: Mm, yum! Can you give me the recipe for that? It sounds like it'd be a good recipe!
[D16:10] Nate: Sure thing! I can give it to you tomorrow, how does that sound?
[D16:11] Joanna: Awesome! I'm going to make it for my family this weekend - can't wait!
[D16:12] Nate: Nice one, Joanna! Hope you and your family like it. Let me know how it went!
[D16:13] Joanna: Sure thing! They love it when I make them new things!
[D16:14] Nate: Then I have no doubt they'll love the icecream!
[D16:15] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.
[D16:16] Nate: Can't wait to hear about it. Have a great day! Take care.
Session date: 2:34 pm on 10 July, 2022
[D17:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, check this out! I won my fourth video game tournament on Friday! It was awesome competing and showing off my skills - and the victory was indescribable. I'm really proud that I can make money doing what I love. This one was online!
[D17:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a television screen showing a trophy and a trophy
[D17:2] Joanna: Congrats, Nate! That's awesome! So proud of you. Your hard work really paid off - keep it up! BTW, I took a road trip for research for my next movie while you were winning. Much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
[D17:3] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your support means a lot to me. That road trip sounds great! Where did you go? Did you discover any interesting places?
[D17:4] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words. I went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest. Got to see some lovely scenery and historic buildings. Checked out the library there, it had a cool old book collection!
[D17:4] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a book shelf filled with lots of books
[D17:5] Nate: That place looks interesting! Did you find any cool books there?
[D17:6] Joanna: I stumbled upon this super cool book from the 1900s with stories and sketches - so awesome to read about the town and the people living there!
[D17:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book with writing on it and a pen

Session date: 10:58 am on 9 October, 2022
[D23:18] Joanna: I watched a classic movie the other day that was awesome - the story was so gripping and the actors were great! It really stuck with me.
[D23:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a framed movie poster with a signed picture
[D23:19] Nate: Wow, that must have been awesome! What would you rate it?
[D23:20] Joanna: Well, it was amazing, so probably 9 or 10 out of 10! Movies can take us to different places and make us feel lots of emotions. What do you love about watching them?
[D23:21] Nate: Well they take me to new worlds and fill me with emotions. Plus, they're great for chilling out after a day.
[D23:22] Joanna: I agree! They have the power to take us away and make us feel things not normally experienced in life. It's a great escape! Especially when you have a room like this!
[D23:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a living room with a tv and candles
[D23:23] Nate: Wow, it's so comfy in there! I should really get a set up like that.
[D23:24] Joanna: You should! It's one thing to watch a movie in a theater, but on a nice comfy couch with a good blanket, I feel so at peace!
[D23:25] Nate: Any pointers on what I should get for my living room to make it comfy like that?
[D23:26] Joanna: Sure! For one, you should get a couch that can sit multiple people so that you can lay down if you want, and make sure its really fluffy! Also invest in a blanket that has a little bit of weight to it, and some lights that can be dimmed.
[D23:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a poster of a man and a woman sitting on a bench
[D23:27] Nate: Sounds like you really got into making your living room! Thanks, I'll try that out for myself!
[D23:28] Joanna: No problem! I get super invested in random little things like that, but I think its all worth it when I end up with random little things that make life so much nicer.
[D23:29] Nate: Thanks for the tip! See you later!
[D23:30] Joanna: See ya Nate!
Session date: 2:01 pm on 21 October, 2022
[D24:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, what's been up? Haven't seen you since we last talked.
[D24:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! I have been revising and perfecting the recipe I made for my family and it turned out really tasty. What's been happening with you?
[D24:3] Nate: Hey Joanna! That's cool. I've been getting so stressed lately because of my tournament progress - tough competitors - but my turtles always cheer me up.
[D24:4] Joanna: Pets have a way of brightening our days. I still have that stuffed animal dog you gave me! I named her Tilly, and she's always with me while I write.
[D24:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a cat laying on the floor in a room
[D24:5] Nate: Glad to hear it! What made you name her Tilly?
[D24:6] Joanna: I used to have a dog back in Michigan with that name, but then I got allergic and we had to get rid of her. The name helps me remember her back when I used to be able to hold and squeeze animal without an allergic reaction!
[D24:7] Nate: That's so touching! Glad the stuffed animal means so much!
[D24:8] Joanna: Tilly helps me stay focused and brings me so much joy. It's amazing how even stuffed animals can do that!
[D24:9] Nate: It really is, I'm not sure I'll ever understand why watching my turtles slowly walk around makes me so happy. But I'm very glad it does.
[D24:10] Joanna: Same here! So have you been up to anything recenly?
[D24:11] Nate: Yeah, I've just been practicing for my next video game tournemant. How about you?
[D24:12] Joanna: Well, I had a bit of a setback recently - another rejection from a production company.
[D24:13] Nate: Bummer, Joanna. Is this the one you sent to a film contest? Rejections suck, but don't forget they don't define you. Keep at it and you'll find the perfect opportunity.
[D24:14] Joanna: Yeah.. Thanks, Nate. It's hard, but I won't let it slow me down. I'm gonna keep grinding and moving ahead.
[D24:15] Nate: That's what I like to hear! I really respect you for that and being able to bounce back whenever something sad happens!
[D24:16] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your encouragement really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and believing in myself.
[D24:17] Nate: You got this, and don't ever forget that you have people cheering you on from the sidelines wherever you go.
[D24:18] Joanna: Thanks! I'll see you around!
[D24:19] Nate: No problem! Catch you later!
Session date: 8:16 pm on 25 October, 2022
[D25:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, what's been up since we last chatted? How's it going?
[D25:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Another movie script that I contributed to was shown on the big screen last Sunday for the first time! It was such a surreal experience to see everything come together. I felt a mix of emotions, but overall, it was a satisfying moment. I've been waiting for this for a long time!
[D25:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a box of cards with a quote on it
[D25:3] Nate: Congrats Joanna! How was it to finally see it on the big screen?

[shares a photo holding a videogame controller]
[D25:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a box with a controller inside of it
[D25:4] Joanna: It was an amazing experience! I'll never forget seeing all of the characters and dialogue I wrote being acted out - it was such a cool feeling. Having all the hard work and determination I put into writing pay off was definitely rewarding. I know this is the third time it's happened, but its just so awesome!
[D25:5] Nate: That must have been amazing. What was your favorite part of it?
[D25:6] Joanna: Seeing my characters I worked so hard on come alive was my favorite part. It felt like they jumped off the page and became real - it was totally surreal.
[D25:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a drawing book with a bunch of drawings on it
[D25:7] Nate: Wow Joanna, those drawings are really incredible! What inspired you to create them?
[D25:8] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! They're visuals of the characters to help bring them alive in my head so I can write better.
[D25:9] Nate: That's a cool way to gain insight into your characters. Where did you get your ideas for them?
[D25:10] Joanna: I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.
[D25:11] Nate: Wow Joanna, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?
[D25:12] Joanna: Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!
[D25:13] Nate: You got it. I was already planning on watching it, but talking to you about it makes me want to watch it even more!
[D25:14] Joanna: Awesome! Well enough about me, what have you been up to?
[D25:15] Nate: I was bored today, so I just took my turtles out for a walk.
[D25:15] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two turtles sitting on a log in a pond
[D25:16] Joanna: Sound fun! Did they have a good time?
[D25:17] Nate: Of course! They look tired from all the walking, so they're relaxing in the tank right now.
[D25:17] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog laying on a rock in a zoo
[D25:18] Joanna: Aww, they're so cute! What do they eat?
[D25:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a spoon full of ice cream and chocolate sauce

Session date: 5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022
[D28:18] Joanna: Make sure you watch other peoples videos first so you get a handle on what your audience likes! That way your videos don't flop when you post them.
[D28:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen displaying a product listing
[D28:19] Nate: Already doing that, but thanks for the advice!
[D28:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen with a message on it
[D28:20] Joanna: No worries, Nate! It's great to support each other in reaching our goals. On another note, check out this pic I got a while back!
[D28:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a sunflower in a field with a sunset in the background
[D28:21] Nate: Wow, that sunset pic looks incredible! What inspired you to take that photo?
[D28:22] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I took that pic on a hike last summer near Fort Wayne. The sunset and the surrounding beauty were just incredible. It was an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.
[D28:23] Nate: That sounds incredible! Nature truly has a way of reminding us to appreciate the beauty around us, and moments like those really stay with you. These critters also make me appreciate life's little joys. And guess what? I got them a new friend!
[D28:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of three turtles sitting on a rock in a pond
[D28:24] Joanna: Wow, what made you get a third?
[D28:25] Nate: Turtles really bring me joy and peace. They have such an effect on us - best buddies ever! I saw another at a pet store and just hade to get him. The tank is big enough now for three, so I figured why not!
[D28:25] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle swimming in a tank with a metal bar
[D28:26] Joanna: Wow! It's always a shock where life will take us next! I bet just last week you would have never thought you would be getting a third turtle this year!
[D28:27] Nate: You got that right, but I'm very happy with the descision and wouldn't have it any other way.
[D28:28] Joanna: Can I come over sometime and watch you play with them? From a distance I mean, since I'm allergic.
[D28:29] Nate: Definitely! I'd love to have you over again. Maybe we can watch one of your movies together or go to the park!
[D28:30] Joanna: For sure! I'd love to do either of those things with you!
[D28:31] Nate: Sounds good. Well I'll make sure I give the turtles a bath before you get here so they're ready to play.
[D28:32] Joanna: Alright, see you tomorrow!
[D28:33] Nate: Bye Joanna!
Session date: 12:06 am on 11 November, 2022
[D29:1] Joanna: Nate, can you believe it? I'm finally filming my own movie from the road-trip script!
[D29:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a clap board with a dog sleeping in a dog bed
[D29:2] Nate: Congrats, Joanna! Not surprised at all that your hard work paid off. Must feel awesome to see your script come alive in a movie! Pretty cool when something you love brings success, right? Tell me more about your movie!
[D29:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a trophy and a game controller on a table
[D29:3] Joanna: Woohoo, thanks Nate! It's pretty wild to see it come alive. Every day on set is awesome and full of potential. Being able to show my vision is awesome.
[D29:4] Nate: I think so too! What's been the coolest moment on set?
[D29:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a fish tank with a fish inside of it
[D29:5] Joanna: One of the actors came up to me and told me how much she liked my script! I was so excited when that happened - it gave me chills!
[D29:6] Nate: Wow Joanna, that must have been so exciting! It's incredible when you get those moments of joy. Anyway, I took my turtles to the beach in Tampa yesterday! They always bring me peace in the craziness of life.
[D29:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle in a sink with a reflection of its head
[D29:7] Joanna: Woah, that's awesome, Nate! You must really enjoy having them around - they're so cool! What do you love most about having them?
[D29:8] Nate: Your completely right! I really love having them around. They're so cool and they make me feel calm. Plus, they don't require much looking after, which is great. I love seeing them soaking in the sun like this.
[D29:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle sitting on a log in a pond
[D29:9] Joanna: That's awesome, Nate! They look so serene and happy. It's great to have something like that.
[D29:10] Nate: Yeah, turtles are like zen masters! They always remind me to slow down and appreciate the small things in life. I'm loving experimenting with flavors right now. Here are some colorful bowls of coconut milk ice cream that I made.
[D29:10] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it
[D29:11] Joanna: Hey Nate, that looks really yummy! The colors and mix-ins give it a nice kick.
[D29:12] Nate: Nice! I'm glad you like it too. This recipe really jazzes it up. Wanna give it a try?
[D29:13] Joanna: Definitely, Nate! That ice cream looks mouthwatering. Thanks so much for offering!
[D29:14] Nate: No worries, Joanna. Hope you enjoy it!
[D29:15] Joanna: Yea, no worries! It was great catching up. Take it easy!

Session date: 1:43 pm on 24 March, 2022
[D6:3] Nate: Congrats! How did it go? Are you excited?
[D6:4] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It went alright. Mixed emotions - definitely excited but also a bit anxious. Keep those fingers crossed!
[D6:5] Nate: Yeah, I get it. Mixed emotions are rough, but I have faith in you! Keep me posted - you got this!
[D6:6] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your support means a lot. I'll make sure to keep you updated. Anything new on your end?
[D6:7] Nate: Yeah actually - I'm currently participating in the video game tournament again and it's INTENSE! There's so much adrenaline flowing.
[D6:8] Joanna: Best of luck in the tournament! It sounds like it would be difficult to go through so many days of intense gaming! This is my go-to place for writing inspiration. It helps me stay sharp and motivated.
[D6:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book shelf filled with books and magazines
[D6:9] Nate: Wow, that's a lot of books. Do you have any advice for someone like me who wants to pursue writing?
[D6:10] Joanna: Definitely! Read lots and try out different genres. Build a solid understanding of literature. Don't be afraid to write and share, even if it's just with friends. Practicing and gathering feedback will make you better. Have faith in yourself and continue following your writing dreams - it's tough but worth it.
[D6:11] Nate: Thanks, Joanna. Really appreciate your help and kind words. I'm going to keep working hard on it and see what happens. Good luck with your project, I'm sure it will turn out great!
[D6:12] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words and support. Let's keep going for our dreams and work hard. Catch you later!
[D6:13] Nate: Bye Joanna! Take care!
Session date: 7:37 pm on 15 April, 2022
[D7:1] Nate: Hey Jo, guess what I did? Dyed my hair last week - come see!
[D7:2] Joanna: Wow, Nate! Can't wait to see it. Must feel so liberating! How're you feeling?
[D7:3] Nate: I'm so stoked about it! Check it out!
[D7:3] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man with purple hair and glasses taking a selfie
[D7:4] Joanna: Wow, your new hair color looks amazing! What made you choose that shade? Tell me all about it!
[D7:5] Nate: Thanks Jo! I picked this color because it's bright and bold - like me! I wanted to stand out from the regular options.
[D7:6] Joanna: That's amazing, Nate! Your boldness really inspired me. It reminded me of this gorgeous sunset I saw while hiking the other day. It made me realize the importance of showing the world who we are.
[D7:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a street with a stop sign and a cloudy sky
[D7:7] Nate: Wow, that sunset looks awesome! Jealous! I bet you had a great time. Are there any more exciting trips coming up for you?
[D7:8] Joanna: I did! the sky was so gorgeous! Wish I had a vacation lined up, but right now my writing is consuming me. Hoping for some good news soon!
[D7:9] Nate: I understand, Joanna. Big projects can be so taxing. Keep me posted on how it goes, alright?
[D7:10] Joanna: Cheers, Nate! Your support means a lot. I'll definitely keep you updated.
[D7:11] Nate: Sounds great, See you soon?
[D7:12] Joanna: Totally! Bye Nate!
[D7:13] Nate: Take care!
Session date: 6:44 pm on 17 April, 2022
[D8:1] Nate: Hey Joanna! Haven't talked with you in a while - how's it going?
[D8:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Great to hear from you. I've been reading a lot in the past week! There's a lot of good books I forgot I owned.
[D8:3] Nate: Sounds fun! I probably also have loads of books I haven't read in years. Sounds like a blast from the past!
[D8:4] Joanna: It really is! On a different note, I found an awesome hiking trail in my hometown yesterday! It was gorgeous. Nature is so inspiring, and it's a great way to reset. Do you know of any good hiking spots?
[D8:5] Nate: I'm not really into hiking but I'm curious to see what the trail looks like! I heard there's a nice trail just north of where I live.
[D8:6] Joanna: Maybe I'll have to convince you to go with me one of these times!
[D8:7] Nate: Maybe! I do like nature, so that might be fun going with someone else.
[D8:8] Joanna: Yeah, nature's awesome! I'm a huge fan of it, that's why I go!
[D8:9] Nate: Agreed, nature has a way of being so inspiring! I'm glad you found a way to reset and find peace in it.
[D8:10] Joanna: Nature's always been my haven. Walking in it, feeling it, hearing the sounds - it's so calming. Worries and stress seem to vanish, and it's just me and the beauty around me.
[D8:11] Nate: It's so crucial to find a little peace and remember life's beauty. For me, it's spending time with my pets and engaging in my hobbies; they let me take a break from reality. It's wild how small things can have such a powerful effect on our happiness, right?
[D8:12] Joanna: Yeah, Nate! Even the small things make life enjoyable and worth it. Taking time for your little friends and doing activities you love are like treasures that remind us how great and peaceful life is. We just gotta savor them!
[D8:13] Nate: Speaking of which, here they go again!
[D8:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle and a strawberry in a bowl
[D8:14] Joanna: So cute! I love your turtles so much!
[D8:15] Nate: Me too! I love watching them play to simply enjoy the peaceful moments of life. Sometimes I even bring them in the kitchen so they can watch me make food like this!
[D8:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bowl of ice cream and a bowl of sprinkles
[D8:16] Joanna: I love your icecream so much! I wish I could make it the way you do!
[D8:17] Nate: Thanks! It's dairy-free and so easy. Wanna get the recipe?
[D8:18] Joanna: Sure! I'm lactose intolerant, so I'll just need the dairy-free recipe! 
[D8:19] Nate: No prob. I made it with coconut milk, vanilla extract, sugar, and a pinch of salt. After chilling it in the fridge, I put it in the ice cream maker and froze it until it was scoopable.
[D8:20] Joanna: Wow, sounds delicious! I'm going to try making it tonight! Thank you for sharing the recipe!
[D8:21] Nate: Hey Joanna, glad I could help. Let me know how it turns out!
[D8:22] Joanna: Got it, Nate. I'll definitely let you know how it turns out. Thanks for sharing the recipe!
Session date: 7:44 pm on 21 April, 2022
[D9:1] Joanna: Hey Nate! Long time no talk! I wanted to tell ya I just joined a writers group. It's unbelievable--such inspirational people who really get my writing. I'm feeling so motivated and supported, it's like I finally belong somewhere!
[D9:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a notepad and a piece of paper
[D9:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! That's awesome! Having a supportive group around you can really make a difference. What kind of projects are you working on with them?

[D26:1] Joanna: Wow, Nate, I'm on fire! I just set up meetings with movie producers — my dreams are comin' true!
[D26:2] Nate: Wow Joanna, nice work! How did it go with those producer meetings?
[D26:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! The meetings went really well. I felt confident discussing my script and vision and they seemed interested and excited. They loved the elements of self-discovery in it. It was so validating to be taken seriously. I'm feeling hopeful and inspired about the future!
[D26:4] Nate: Way to go, Joanna! Putting yourself out there is really brave and winning recognition for your hard work feels great. It's just like when I win a video game tournament - it feels awesome! I'm so proud of you and so glad you're feeling hopeful and inspired.
[D26:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a television screen showing a game being played
[D26:5] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot. Writing isn't always easy but moments like these make me appreciate it. I'm so thankful for all the opportunities. Last week, I found these old notebooks with my early writings - it was cool to see how far I've come.
[D26:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a list of things to write
[D26:6] Nate: That's cool! You must love seeing how you've grown as an artist. Is there a favorite piece from your early writings that stands out to you?
[D26:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle laying on a bed of rocks and gravel

[D26:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle laying on a bed of rocks and gravel
